abstract: Here we are again. It is almost July and we are all working remotely, keeping SMPTE’s business running. Given the current state of the global pandemic, I am uncertain when we will actually get back to a routine of using office space. Many companies have already announced that the cost of office space far outweighs any benefits. In any case, we are doing our best.
